name: elysium-mainnet-gloam
rpcUrl: FILL IN: Elysium mainnet RPC that answers eth_getLogs
poseidon: FILL IN: the Poseidon Gloam's vault uses (its poseidon2())
factory: FILL IN: Cloak's v4 launch factory on mainnet
safe: FILL IN: the owner wallet (a software wallet, its own seed): guard controller, ecosystem approver. The treasury is a separate wallet. Called safe for history; a multisig later via transferController
pauser: FILL IN: the owner wallet (launch pauser: can only stop new admissions)
_feeRecipient: The launch vault's fee is paid in launch tokens; it's burned (decided Nov 10), so Cloak never sells into its creators' pools. Anyone can call collectFees(token) to burn what's collected. The relay's gas is topped up from the treasury in HYPE.
ecosystemFeeRecipient: FILL IN: the treasury wallet (KNTQ and other outside tokens' fees)
_withdrawFeeBps: Our launch and ecosystem vaults' withdrawal fee (a swap out of them is a withdrawal), at most 100 (1%). 25 = 0.25% (decided Nov 10, as v1).

assets._pool: USDC's deepest native-HYPE v4 pool with no hook (Nov 10 scan): 0.3% / 60, about 27,300 HYPE and 2.0M USDC in range. The router trades USDC against HYPE through it, and through HYPE against every launch and outside token (two pools, one private swap).

ecosystem._note: Outside tokens (CloakEcosystemVault). Cloak vets a launchpad's code once (launchpads below: the script deploys a CloakLaunchpadCheck for each and prints the owner wallet's approveLaunchpad call). The owner wallet then lists that launchpad's tokens at once, choosing by market cap and importance; KNTQ is vetted on its own (no launchpad). Fixed at deploy for every listing: a plain native-HYPE v4 pool (no hook) with at least minHypeLiquidity HYPE in range, a market cap of at least minMcapHype HYPE, caps at most maxPerDepositBps / maxTotalBps of its supply.
ecosystem._launchpads: Each vetted launchpad: { name, factory, selector }. factory is its contract that records the tokens it made; selector is a view f(address token) there that returns non-zero for its tokens and zero otherwise (for example isToken(address) or tokenInfo(address)). A token then names its launchpad with "launchpad": name.

tokens._token: KNTQ on Elysium mainnet (Kinetiq Governance Token, 18 decimals, not a proxy), found in the Nov 10 pool scan. Kinetiq's docs list 0x0000...c2d6, which is KNTQ on HyperEVM and has no code on Elysium.
tokens._pool: KNTQ's deepest native-HYPE v4 pool with no hook: 0.3% fee, tick spacing 60, about 30,200 HYPE and 5.6M KNTQ in range on Nov 10. Others: 1% / 200 (about 28,000 HYPE), 0.8% / 120 (about 5,500 HYPE).
tokens._caps: 5 and 50 bps of the Elysium supply: about 6,500 KNTQ per deposit and 65,000 KNTQ in total.

ecosystem._minMcapHype: The market cap counts the token's supply on Elysium only (a bridged token's Elysium supply, not its full supply): KNTQ, with about 13.0M KNTQ on Elysium at about 186 KNTQ per HYPE, is about 69,900 HYPE (scan of Nov 10). 50,000 HYPE is about $3.7M at HYPE near $73.

_scan: Elysium mainnet (99901), Nov 10: Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0xe2e105d3f7209a9da11f83ccf3e7398a753823f1 (81,107 pools). USDC 0xb47c4C8F73F009CC0C0d3f92B388d13E293F0B65 (6 decimals). WHYPE 0xbA876237B0F021A6c6D852d6c26E107997cC5E81.
